question: Which city hosted the Meeting of the BRICS Ministers of Foreign Affairs on 4 June 2018?
solution: The correct answer is __**Pretoria, South Africa**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Meeting of BRICS Ministers of Foreign Affairs** was held in **Pretoria, South Africa** on **4 June 2018**. • The meeting aimed to strengthen cooperation among the BRICS nations (Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa) in areas such as **economics, trade, and diplomacy**. • **South Africa** hosted the meeting as part of its role as the **chair of BRICS** for the year 2018. • Discussions during the meeting focused on **international peace**, economic reforms, and strategies to promote sustainable development among member countries. • BRICS is an important platform for emerging economies, and South Africa plays a significant role as the only African member of this group.
